nativeAxes.origin: Native +X east,+Z south and +Y up; heading0. mb21 dated2014 survey explicitly locates eight-tier crossed rack on north and two trough antennas on west; September2023 close-up corroborates their configuration. Arup1972 Fig4 north arrow locates four GPO platforms on north. Entrance approximately east is inferred from ground photo with north platforms to its right, uncertainty20degrees; no exact door bearing is claimed.

sourceFacts.heightConflict: Modern319m is a photo-proportioned modeled envelope, not a height reported in the cited mb21 page. Arqiva2023 retains historical330.4m.
sourceFacts.basis: Arup1972 sets concrete274.32m,24.38m base/6.4m top and20-bay turret. The mapped17.6m ring is a position control, not a sizing survey. The modern319m modeled antenna envelope is photo-proportioned from February/September2023, not a verified measured current height; owner2023 still quotes historical330.4m. Segment heights, turret external7.05m radius, service-door phases, minor antenna inventory/cage details and entrance east bearing are reconstructed. Lower gallery uses2011 and upper arrays2023 references; detached station buildings, ducts/fences, hidden internals and operating radio equipment excluded. Host terrain supplies ground height; no footprint replacement. Original master is preserved separately.

appearance.identity: Individual tapered concrete broadcasting tower, 20-bay glazed turret, four lower cantilever platforms, antenna mounting rings and modern shortened two-stage radome. True shaft-door recesses, cabin windows, panel frames, safety rails, ladders and obstruction lights use shared procedural surfaces.
appearance.master: Exact original source remains callable through emleyMoor.build; reviewed source rotates north platforms and approximately east entrance without moving upper array frame.
appearance.browser: Whole tapered concrete shaft,20-bay cabin, upper galleries, four north platforms, lower antenna ring and current two-stage radome retained. Shaft sampling, safety rails, lift seams and small dishes decrease with distance.

geographic.evidence: Named communication tower inside the exact-QID Emley Moor station parcel. Mean ring center; the circular outline cannot supply entrance azimuth.
geographic.limitations: Named tower identity must be bound separately from the QID site polygon. Site entrance and platform azimuth, dated antenna dimensions and terrain fit remain pending.
